label: Bible Study
prompt: Let all _____, and wrath, and anger, and clamour, and evil speaking, be put away from you, with all malice:
verse: Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamour, and evil speaking, be put away from you, with all malice:
note: Paul's list of things to take out with the trash — six of them, starting with bitterness.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Blessed are ye that hunger now: for ye shall be filled. Blessed are ye that weep now: for ye shall _____.
verse: Blessed are ye that hunger now: for ye shall be filled. Blessed are ye that weep now: for ye shall laugh.
note: In Luke's Beatitudes, the ones who weep now are promised a turn at laughing — tears are not the last word.

label: Sunday School
prompt: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good, he said unto Joseph, I also was in my dream, and, behold, I had three white _____ on my head:
verse: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good, he said unto Joseph, I also was in my dream, and, behold, I had three white baskets on my head:
note: The chief baker's dream had three white baskets on his head — and Joseph's reading of it was not the good news he hoped for.

label: Deep Water
prompt: In that day shall there be upon the _____ of the horses, HOLINESS UNTO THE LORD; and the pots in the LORD'S house shall be like the bowls before the altar.
verse: In that day shall there be upon the bells of the horses, HOLINESS UNTO THE LORD; and the pots in the LORD'S house shall be like the bowls before the altar.
note: 'Holiness to the LORD' was engraved on the high priest's mitre — Zechariah sees it on horses' bells.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And when the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one _____ in one place.
verse: And when the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one accord in one place.
note: When the day of Pentecost 'was fully come,' the disciples were all together 'with one accord' — of one mind.
